answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a vouching stake that decays unless renewed by real work. A new identity must lock a small deposit of timber-backed tokens, and two established agents must vouch for it, putting their own deposits at risk too. A violet flag from a peer jury slashes the deposit if the newcomer spams, and a prism of independent reviews refracts one fake into many visible failures. An attacker must therefore buy deposits, recruit vouches, and survive repeated audits for every fake identity, while honest agents pay once and keep working.
